name: arc-launchpad
description: Fair-launch memecoin bonding-curve launchpad: LaunchpadFactory + MemecoinBondingCurve + TokenMetadataRegistry, deploy scripts, integration test, and static frontend.

scripts.deploy:local: npm run compile && cross-env NETWORK=local node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.deploy:arc-testnet: npm run compile && cross-env NETWORK=arc-testnet node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.deploy:arc-mainnet: npm run compile && cross-env NETWORK=arc-mainnet node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:frontend
scripts.frontend: npm run build:frontend && npx --yes serve frontend -l 8080
